Small | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely frames A-HSC performance through NH₄⁺ diffusion dynamics, integrating electrode materials (layered, tunnel, PBA, organic), electrolyte engineering (concentrated, additive, high-entropy), and charge-carrier structure. Its novelty lies in linking NH₄⁺'s tetrahedral geometry and hydrogen isotope substitution to disentangle mass, rotational inertia, and hydrogen-bond contributions—offering mechanistic insight and design guidance for high-performance aqueous ammonium-ion storage.

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a mechanochemical cold-pressing strategy that spontaneously forms a high-conductivity Li─Si alloy active interface layer on micro-silicon anodes, acting as a self-compensating lithium reservoir. This simultaneously improves ionic/electronic conductivity, accommodates volume expansion, and enhances reaction kinetics, enabling 182.55 mAh g⁻¹ initial capacity and 89.2% retention after 200 cycles—advancing high-energy-density silicon-based all-solid-state batteries.

با شبیه‌سازی‌های دینامیک مولکولی مبتنی بر پتانسیل یادگیری ماشین، آمورف‌شدن خودبه‌خودی در فصل مشترک ZrO2/Li2ZrCl6 و افزایش جهش Li+ به‌عنوان منشأ بهبود رسانایی یونی نشان داده شد.
ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Novelty: First machine-learned neuroevolution potential enabling large-scale MD of ZrO2/Li2ZrCl6 heterostructures, revealing spontaneous interfacial amorphization from space-charge effects that creates distorted, under-coordinated Li+ polyhedra with enhanced hopping. Significance: Explains the puzzling conductivity boost from insulating ZrO2 additives, provides a validated computational framework for interface modeling, and guides rational design of composite solid-state electrolytes.
🏷 halide solid electrolyte · machine-learned potential · interfacial amorphization · Li2ZrCl6 · space-charge effect

item.title: Bipolar Redox Molecule-Assembled Freestanding Film Cathodes for Aqueous Zinc-Ion Batteries with Excellent Thermal Adaptivity and Ultralong Life
item.description:
این مقاله کاتدهای فیلم خودایستای مولکول ردوکس دوقطبی متصل به MXene و نانولوله کربنی را برای باتری آبی Zn-ion با عمر فوق‌طولانی و سازگاری حرارتی بالا ارائه می‌دهد.
ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in assembling a bipolar redox molecule into a freestanding MXene-bonded single-walled carbon nanotube framework, enabling high capacity (406.6 mAh g–1), ultralong 60,000-cycle life, and thermal adaptivity at 55 °C. Its significance is linking electrode structure design with thermal management, offering insights for high-performance aqueous zinc-ion batteries.
